scripts.wire: cargo run -q --features gen --bin wiregen --manifest-path ../crates/fm-core/Cargo.toml -- ts > src/lib/serial/wire.ts && cargo run -q --features gen --bin wiregen --manifest-path ../crates/fm-core/Cargo.toml -- fixtures > ../crates/fm-core/tests/fixtures/frames.jsonl
scripts.wasm: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$(cd .. && pwd)=/petboard" cargo build -q --release --manifest-path ../crates/wasmfmt/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/wasm/pkg ../crates/wasmfmt/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wasmfmt.wasm
